Maya Patel: Heads up — QBR ask from NorthStar SI. They want a quick MDF top-up for co-sell demo next week. Need approval flow. @Ethan any chance to reallocate from standby bucket? :eyes:
Ethan Rivera: How much are they asking for?
Maya Patel: $40k one-off for joint events + demo credits. Budget code: MDF-Q3-SI. Timeline: spend by 03/25.
Lola Nguyen: That’s tight. Current MDF runway shows ~$55k uncommitted but some of that is earmarked for marketplace promos.
Samir Desai: If we shrink co-marketing line by 20% from the QBR contingency we can free ~30k. Still 10k short.
Maya Patel: Could we use a partial accelerate from partner success carryover? @Lola any flexibility on earmarks?
Lola Nguyen: We have a pending hold on an APAC pilot (10k). We could release it but needs approval from sales ops.
Ethan Rivera: I can fast-track a one-time exception for up to 15k if legal sign-off on co-marketing deliverables present. Need a short SOW & measurable KPIs.
Maya Patel: I'll draft SOW today. KPIs: 3 demos -> 1 POC -> MRR target $75k. Also require Redwood logo on joint landing page + marketplace listing.
Samir Desai: Also propose making this a conditional MDF: release 50% up-front, remainder on KPIs at 60 days.
Partnerships Bot: Reminder: MDF spend >$25k requires executive approval per policy. SLA for approval 48 hours.
Ethan Rivera: Good point — I'll flag to execs. @Maya please share SOW and budget matrix by EOD and I’ll attach to approval packet.
Maya Patel: Dropping SOW + budget matrix in thread: https://drive.redwood.co/s/NS-SOW-QBR. Also attaching scorecard snapshot showing NorthStar SI tier = Gold, QBR health green.
Lola Nguyen: Reviewed scorecard — co-sell velocity looks decent. Approving to proceed with conditional MDF request. Move to approvals queue.
Samir Desai: I'll update the partner tiering ledger and note contingency reallocation.
Maya Patel: Thanks team. Will loop in Sales Ops and send final doc to execs. :thumbsup:
